How it works
    

  1. If all data is stuck in column A, it is split on Tab and comma automatically (same as Excel: Data > Text to Columns > Delimited > Tab + Comma).
    2. 

  2. The date defaults to yesterday. If the file has no data for yesterday, the latest date in the file is used. You can change it.
    3. 

  3. Left table "first attempt success rate": only Ofd Num = 1. Right table "delivery successful rate": all attempts. Both show each driver's not sign / sign / (blank) share and count.
    4. 

  4. Success Rate = the sign % in the Grand Total row of the left table (same as the old template).
    5. 

  5. The download contains the "performance page" sheet (both tables, values already calculated, no Refresh needed) and the OFD data sheet.
    6.
